_comment: Sibling of layout/pex/pex.json and layout/pex-ring/pex.json, one level
further up the hierarchy: extracts the fully-composed, DRC-clean and
klt-lvs-MATCHING array GDS -- layout/ro_array_core's own canonical
ro_array_core.gds (132/132 devices, 96/96 nets against
design/ro_array_core.spice's own .subckt ro_array_core; see that
directory's README) -- with `klt extract --parasitics`,
and rewrites the result the same way: `layout/bin/pex-netlist.py` is
shared, unmodified, across all three descriptors.
This descriptor previously sourced layout/ro_array_core-placement-poc's
ro_array_core_signal9_poc.gds, because the --check-reproducible recipe
had not landed yet. It has, and the recipe additionally draws
ring1..4's and xa1..3's own vss taps, so the PoC stream is superseded.
The swap is measurable, not cosmetic: same 132 devices / 96 nets (the
straps are not LVS-visible -- vss was already one net electrically),
but total C to substrate moves 367.43 fF -> 392.44 fF (+6.8%) and total
series R 81891.77 -> 81935.47 ohm. Every sim/post-layout-ro-array-core
number is measured against the canonical GDS; see this directory's
README, 'Which GDS, and why the vss straps mattered'.
cells[].ports is design/ro_array_core.spice's own
`.subckt ro_array_core en1 en2 en3 en4 vddr1 vddr2 vddr3 vddr4 vdd vss
xo ro1 ro2 ro3 ro4` port order. Every other extracted pin is internal:
t1/t2 (the XOR tree's own inter-stage nets, promoted to physical pins by
the met1/met2 stub-and-bridge routing layout/README.md's 'Increment 6'
and 'Increment 7' sections describe), rn1-rn4 (design's own ring-to-
buffer net names), sig_n1-sig_n4 x4 (one set per ring, the same
per-gate two-pass-composition promotion layout/pex-ring/pex.json already
aliases at ring scope, now recurring four times since the array flattens
four ring instances), py_g x4 (one per ring's own ro_nand2), and
xor_an/xor_bn x3 (one set per xor2 instance -- these are xor2's own
unlabelled internal inverter nets, never promoted to a design-level
name at any scope). Bare, already-$N-disambiguated internal names with
no '|' in them (mid, py, ny and their $1.. siblings) need no alias at
all -- canonicalize() only requires one for a joined ('|') name, and
sanitize() already makes klt's own $N suffixes unique; see
layout/bin/pex-netlist.py's module docstring.
